characteristic_progression: patch  plaque  tumour  lymph node  visceral
heme_involvement_pattern.staging_system: TNMB (skin patches/plaques/tumours + nodes + blood + viscera). Different from Ann Arbor.

biomarkers.name: CD3+, CD4+, CD8- with loss of pan-T markers (CD7 loss common)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Aberrant T-cell phenotype supports MF over reactive dermatoses

biomarkers.name: Clonal TCR-b3 rearrangement
biomarkers.prevalence: Common in established MF, but detection is less sensitive in early-stage disease
biomarkers.clinical_use: Same clonal population across skin/blood/nodes confirms MF; early-stage MF may be oligoclonal or nondiagnostic

biomarkers.name: CD30
biomarkers.prevalence: Variable; more frequent in large-cell transformation than in conventional early MF
biomarkers.clinical_use: Brentuximab vedotin (ALCANZA trial): approved for CD30-expressing MF/pcALCL after prior systemic therapy

biomarkers.name: CCR4
biomarkers.prevalence: Frequently expressed in MF/CTCL, but prevalence is variable and not reliably ~90% in MF specifically
biomarkers.clinical_use: Mogamulizumab (anti-CCR4)  approved for R/R MF and S�e9zary syndrome (MAVORIC trial)

biomarkers.name: TNMB staging (skin extent, nodal, blood, visceral)
biomarkers.clinical_use: Primary prognostic staging system guiding skin-directed versus systemic management; advanced stage (eg, tumours, significant nodal/blood/visceral involvement) generally warrants systemic therapy

biomarkers.name: Large-cell transformation (LCT)
biomarkers.prevalence: Occurs in a subset of advanced or longstanding cases
biomarkers.clinical_use: Defined by large cells comprising >25% of the infiltrate or forming microscopic nodules; adverse; often CD30+; may support brentuximab consideration

histomorphological_subtype.primary_pattern: Small to medium-sized T cells with cerebriform (convoluted) nuclei infiltrating epidermis (epidermotropism) with formation of Pautrier microabscesses (intraepithelial lymphocyte aggregates)
variants: folliculotropic MF (often associated with more aggressive course than classic early MF)

tumor_microenvironment.immune_context: Skin-tropic biology drives skin-directed therapy paradigm; CCR4 expression can enable mogamulizumab; CD30 expression in a subset enables brentuximab vedotin (ALCANZA)
tumor_microenvironment.stromal_features: Epidermotropism with Pautrier microabscesses is classic; band-like dermal infiltrate in early lesions

cellular_states_and_lineage.cell_of_origin: Mature skin-homing CD4+ memory T cells
cellular_states_and_lineage.developmental_lineage: Mesoderm  lymphoid (skin-homing mature CD4+ T cells)
cellular_states_and_lineage.differentiation_state: Skin-homing memory T-cell phenotype with characteristic cerebriform (convoluted) nuclei; commonly CD3+, CD4+, CD8-, CD45RO+, CCR4+, CLA+ (cutaneous lymphocyte antigen)  recapitulates skin-tropic memory T-cell biology
cellular_states_and_lineage.lineage_plasticity: Skin-tropic biology drives skin-directed therapy paradigm; CCR4 expression in many cases supports mogamulizumab use; CD30 expression in a subset enables brentuximab vedotin (ALCANZA); large-cell transformation (>25% large cells or microscopic nodules of large cells) represents disease progression with worse outcome and often CD30+ phenotype
